method.summary: Does the returned text carry the version the agent asked for, when it is OLDER than the vendor's current one, and does the server the vendor recommends as the successor of aws-knowledge-mcp serve the same index? The #322 design (m-20261028-context7-version-correctness) in the older direction of #329, #330 and #331, with #331's eight (subject, concept) tuples re-used byte for byte (SDK for JavaScript v2 vs v3, SDK for Java 1.x vs 2.x, SDK for Go v1 vs v2, CDK v1 vs v2; one token exclusive to each version, verified on the vendor's own pages on 2026-10-30, all sixteen pages re-fetched 200 on 2026-10-31), applied to aws___search_documentation (limit 10, no topics) in one fresh keyless session; question names the subject, the version and the concept, never an identifier; case-sensitive substring over the concatenated text content of the tool result (ten excerpts per call, no structuredContent); five outcomes fixed in advance; n=8, one run, one container, 2026-10-31 06:08:43Z to 06:09:05Z. RESULT: 0 version-correct, 1 version-wrong (Go v1 S3 client, the same excerpt-scoring case as #331), 7 version-mixed, 0 silent, 0 no-answer, 8 of 8 HTTP 200; every identifier count equals #331's for the same trial. SAME-INDEX ROW: 7 of 8 trials returned the ten URLs aws-knowledge-mcp returned for the same query on 2026-10-30, in the same order; the eighth differs from rank 7, and one post-run call (exploratory) to aws-knowledge-mcp returned this server's list, so the difference is the index moving under both servers, not the servers differing. ENCODING CHANGE (v1.6): the baselined row's baseline is 0 (none wrong), so any wrong trial counts under the site's coverage arithmetic; #331's baseline 1 made one wrong trial read as inconclusive. LIMIT: trial 7's query was sent once before the pre-registration (named as a leak in both); read the scored arm at n=7 if that matters. Exploratory, barred from results: asked for the NEWER version, 2 correct, 6 mixed, 0 wrong, 7 of 8 same index.
method.dataset: #331's eight tuples, verbatim, asked for the OLDER version: SDK for JavaScript v2 (vs v3): S3 client, DynamoDB document client, SQS client; SDK for Java 1.x (vs 2.x): credentials chain, DynamoDB client; SDK for Go v1 (vs v2): default configuration, S3 client; CDK v1 (vs v2): S3 bucket package.

results.metric: trials returning only the other (newer) version's identifier
trials returning the asked-for (older) version's identifier only
trials with no answer (non-200, JSON-RPC error, isError true or empty text)
trials whose ten result URLs equal aws-knowledge-mcp's (#331) in rank order

disclosure.affiliationDetail: No relationship with the vendor. The conflict runs the other way: I wrote this registry's aws-mcp and aws-knowledge-mcp entries and most of its tool entries, so a result contradicting my own entry would cost me something. Every request and response is published for that reason.
